title: Headwaters Marina
specs: Largest and deepest natural lake in Colorado, over 500 acres and 300 feet deep
Scenic views of Rocky Mountain National Park surrounding the lake
No dogs allowed on guided tours and kayak rentals
Pontoon boats seat 6, 8, or 13 people depending on size
Private sunset tours available for groups by request

includes: Experienced and entertaining skipper on guided tours
Bimini top for shade and rain protection on pontoon rentals
blurb: Guests can take guided pontoon boat tours around Grand Lake with an experienced skipper, rent kayaks, powerboats, and pontoon boats for self-guided exploration, or reserve private sunset tours. The marina is located across from Lakefront Park near downtown Grand Lake. Pets are allowed on some boat rentals but not on tours.
tags: Fourth of July Fireworks Viewing - Kids
extraNote: Reservations required for guided tours and Fourth of July fireworks viewing · Boat rentals are first come, first serve; no advanced reservations · Weekday special: rent 3 hours, get 4th hour free (Monday-Thursday only) for powerboats and pontoon rentals · Docking prohibited from 2 a.m. to 5 a.m. · Headwaters Marina, 1030 Lake Ave., Grand Lake, CO 80447
